provenance: Synthetic inputs; built by showpapers_format create, apply --changes and upgrade.

cases.name: minimal
cases.description: The smallest profile 4 file: one original and nothing else. Every optional section is omitted.

cases.name: types-and-titles
cases.description: Titles, created times, automatic-title flags and every type layer: detected, suggested, selected by the person, and a custom type on a generic paper.

cases.name: reading-and-reviewed-details
cases.description: An on-device reading (page, block, lines, words, regions, confidences, reader result) with details that point at its lines: confirmed, corrected, a date with a normalized value, and remembered removed suggestions.

cases.name: custom-and-agent-details
cases.description: Custom details the person typed, and details, a type and quoted evidence proposed by an external AI agent, pending review, plus one agent suggestion the person rejected.

cases.name: dates-and-reminders
cases.description: Date details and both reminder kinds: one that follows a confirmed end date and one on a date the person picked.

cases.name: people
cases.description: People, the owner (isMe), and who each paper belongs to.

cases.name: folders-and-rules
cases.description: Personal folders with colors, icons, purposes and automatic filing rules (document types, a case receipt, reviewed-detail clauses, exclusions), built-in folder placements and category icons.

cases.name: pins
cases.description: Pinned papers in the person's order.

cases.name: notes
cases.description: Notes with rich text (bold, italic, inline paper links, checklist lines), legacy checklist rows with their own paper links and remembered checks.

cases.name: relationships
cases.description: Relationships between papers: a confirmed same-case link the person accepted, a renewal with a direction, duplicates the person kept apart, and a suggestion from an external agent.

cases.name: folder-hierarchy
cases.description: A preserved folder tree with root, personal-folder, built-in, group and unspecified parents; matching names in different sibling groups are valid.

cases.name: many-complete-records
cases.description: 121 originals, paper records, readings and Notes, with 121 references in a Note, folder and pins; 485 ZIP entries remain byte-bounded.

cases.name: everything
cases.description: Every profile 4 feature in one collection.

cases.name: everything-changed
cases.description: The combined collection after applying the example changes document: agent details and a type suggestion pending review, a new person, folder membership, a pin, a suggested relationship and a new note.

cases.name: upgraded-from-profile-3
cases.description: The profile 3 interoperability archive upgraded to profile 4 at the next revision: notes, rows and links kept exactly; folders gain the default look.
